product_one_liner.value: Speak_ uses AI to review applicants’ resumes against recruiter-defined criteria, helping hiring teams identify strong candidates.
product_one_liner.notes: Speak_’s homepage (https://speak.careers/) describes it as an AI recruitment partner that reviews resumes; its FAQ says it evaluates applicants using custom criteria recruiters set.

pricing_page.notes: The Speak_ homepage (https://speak.careers/) has a Pricing navigation link and displays plan details, including Free and Pro plans. A public pricing page exists.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Speak_’s homepage (https://speak.careers/) includes customer testimonials identifying Alpine Home Air, Prepared Hero, and Evidence Action. | named_customers.0: The testimonial on Speak_’s homepage identifies Alpine Home Air. | named_customers.1: The testimonial on Speak_’s homepage identifies Prepared Hero. | named_customers.2: The testimonial on Speak_’s homepage identifies Evidence Action.

employee_band.notes: The LinkedIn company profile for speak.careers (https://linkedin.com/company/speakcareers) reports 18 employees, which falls in the 11-20 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company profile gives Speak_’s headquarters as Boulder, Colorado, United States (https://www.cbinsights.com/company/speak-); the requested city is Boulder. | hq_country: The company profile identifies Speak_’s headquarters as Boulder, Colorado, United States (https://www.cbinsights.com/company/speak-); the requested country is United States.

founded_year.notes: CB Insights’ Speak_ company profile (https://www.cbinsights.com/company/speak-) says it was founded in 2021.

eng_blog.notes: The Speak_ blog index (https://speak.careers/blog) shows recruiting, career and podcast content. Its engineer-related article is “The New Face of Software - 18 Engineers to Follow,” not a post about how Speak_ is built. The index does not show two engineer-authored technical posts, so this is false.

public_docs.notes: The homepage navigation (https://speak.careers/) lists product, testimonial, pricing, demo, affiliate, and sign-up links, but no product docs or help center. Its FAQ supplies basic answers rather than a multi-article product documentation site, so this is false.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Speak_’s Wellfound jobs page (https://wellfound.com/company/speak_-1/jobs) states that Speak_ has not added any jobs yet; there is no open AI/ML role.

model_provider.notes: The privacy policy (https://speak.careers/privacy), homepage FAQ (https://speak.careers/), and an article about Speak_’s recruiting AI (https://blog.hrflow.ai/ai-powered-hrtech-of-the-week-speak_) refer to AI tools or custom-tuned signals but do not name a model or model provider. The provider is unknown.

compliance_certs.notes: Speak_’s privacy policy (https://speak.careers/privacy) is a legal page; its disclosed text names none of SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS. Therefore the list is empty.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: CB Insights’ Speak_ funding page (https://www.cbinsights.com/company/speak-/financials) labels the latest round Seed. | funding_date: CB Insights’ Speak_ funding page (https://www.cbinsights.com/company/speak-/financials) dates the latest Seed round to March 5, 2025; Aventure also describes a most-recent round in March 2025 (https://aventure.vc/companies/speak-boulder-co-us). The requested YYYY-MM value is 2025-03. | funding_amount_usd: CB Insights’ funding page for Speak_ (https://www.cbinsights.com/company/speak-/financials) identifies its latest round as Seed for $0.12M on March 5, 2025, or $120,000. Aventure reports a different amount for a March 2025 round (https://aventure.vc/companies/speak-boulder-co-us), so the amount is reported from the explicit latest-round table and confidence is medium.

raised_18mo.notes: CB Insights dates the latest Seed round to March 5, 2025 (https://www.cbinsights.com/company/speak-/financials), before the 18-month window beginning May 9, 2025. Thus the answer is false.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Speak_’s Wellfound jobs page (https://wellfound.com/company/speak_-1/jobs) says it has not added any jobs yet, so it is not hiring SDRs, BDRs, or account executives there.

launched_6mo.notes: Speak_ has an Updates page and launch history. Its Enhanced Candidate Matching announcement (https://speak.careers/updates/enhanced-candidate-matching) is undated, while its dated launch announcement is from October 2023 (https://andreaguendelman.substack.com/p/and-yes-we-are-launching-speak_). The available evidence does not establish whether a product or major feature launched in the six-month window, so this is unknown.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The About page (https://speak.careers/about) does not provide a team list. Techstars described Andrea Guendelman as Speak_’s CEO in June 2025 (https://www.techstars.com/blog/founder-advice/speak-founder-andrea-guendelman-cuts-through-resume-noise), and her profile records a Speak_ Founder role ending January 1, 2026 (https://linkedin.com/in/andrea-guendelman-78b32643). The available profile does not explicitly identify a CEO/C-level departure on that date, so the requested change cannot be confirmed and is unknown.
